topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon it, hidden away in a drawer we seldom open. His bucket list. A piece of paper, fragile, yellowed at the edges, with dreams penciled in bold and neat rows. Things we'd talked about, laughed about, even planned. Now, everything feels heavy, each item a weight pressing down. The world beyond these walls seems so vast, so full of possibilities that no longer feel like they belong to us. I trace the lines of his handwriting, wondering if the dreams will outlast the dreamer. The room is quiet, too quiet, with the gentle hum of the old clock ticking away the seconds. Each tick is a reminder, each tock a promise we made in whispers.
